name: yaoharee-lahtee-math
description: Information Discrete Math — a readout-first mathematical foundation that keeps continuum concepts (real numbers, limits, angles/degrees, points of zero size, infinity) from being silently injected into your math. Developed by Yaoharee Lahtee.

plugins.name: information-discrete-math
plugins.description: Load before writing any mathematics, physics, or geometry. Everything an agency reads is a finite, discrete, rational readout; the continuum (ℝ-completeness, h→0, +∞, a point of zero size, a continuum angle) is a NON-READOUT never to be silently injected. Carries the contaminated-concept → discrete-replacement table (angle/degree, zero, infinity, point, distance, continuity, ℝ, π, derivative, operator), a pre-write checklist, and the machine-checked discrete number ladder D→ℤ→ℚ→ℝ with the retained-information operator.
